adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable`, access is denied unless `URI(request.referer || '').host == SiteSetting.embeddable_host`, so requests with no Referer (e.g., referrer-stripped policies) will always raise `Discourse::InvalidAccess`, and only a single host is supported (no allowance for multiple embedding hosts). This is grounded in the diff, but it’s a product/security tradeoff rather than a clear defect.
